parsed_json.up: Select compound_chembl_id from molecule_dictionary.chembl_id, canonical_smiles from compound_structures, compound_key from compound_records, pubmed_id_or_doi as COALESCE(CAST(docs.pubmed_id AS TEXT), docs.doi), assay_description from assays, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment from activities, target_chembl_id from target_dictionary.chembl_id, target_name from target_dictionary.pref_name, target_organism from target_dictionary.organism. Join activities to assays on assay_id, assays to target_dictionary on tid, activities to molecule_dictionary on molregno, molecule_dictionary to compound_structures on molregno, activities to compound_records on record_id, activities to docs on doc_id. Filter target_dictionary.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL203', activities.standard_type = 'IC50', activities.standard_units = 'nM', target_dictionary.target_type = 'SINGLE PROTEIN', target_dictionary.organism = 'Homo sapiens', canonical_smiles IS NOT NULL, and at least one of docs.pubmed_id or docs.doi is non-null. Return DISTINCT rows over all output columns. Sort by compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, target_organism.
